name: mobile_list_apps
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。List all the installed apps on the device

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_launch_app
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。Launch an app on mobile device. Use this to open a specific app. You can find the package name of the app by calling mobile_list_apps.

packageName.description: The package name of the app to launch

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_get_screen_size
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。Get the screen size of the mobile device in pixels

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。Click on the screen, either at x,y coordinates or on an element by its ref (e.g. "@e5") from the latest mobile_list_elements_on_screen result. Prefer ref when the element is listed.

x.description: The x coordinate to click on the screen, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

y.description: The y coordinate to click on the screen, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

ref.description: Element ref from mobile_list_elements_on_screen, e.g. "@e5". Takes precedence over x,y

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_list_elements_on_screen
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。List elements on screen with their ref, coordinates, and display text or accessibility label. Use the ref with mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates. Refs and coordinates stay valid as long as the screen does not change; re-list only after navigation or a layout change.

format.description: Output format. "text" (default) is one compact line per element, "json" is a json array

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_press_button
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。Press a button on device

button.description: The button to press. Supported buttons: BACK (android only), HOME, VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN, ENTER, DPAD_CENTER (android tv only), DPAD_UP (android tv only), DPAD_DOWN (android tv only), DPAD_LEFT (android tv only), DPAD_RIGHT (android tv only)

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_swipe_on_screen
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。Swipe on the screen

x.description: The x coordinate to start the swipe from, in pixels. If not provided, uses center of screen

y.description: The y coordinate to start the swipe from, in pixels. If not provided, uses center of screen

distance.description: The distance to swipe in pixels. Defaults to 400 pixels for iOS or 30% of screen dimension for Android

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_type_keys
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。Type text into the focused element 英文和数字输入。中文请读取输入框后使用 mobile_set_text；不要用拼音代替用户指定文字。

submit.description: Whether to submit the text. If true, the text will be submitted as if the user pressed the enter key.

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_take_screenshot
description: 操作指定的 Wearing 手机资源。Take a screenshot of the mobile device. Use this to understand what's on screen, if you need to press an element that is available through view hierarchy then you must list elements on screen instead. The screenshot is usually smaller than the screen, so when the device reports its screen size the result also states how to convert positions in the screenshot into screen coordinates before tapping. Do not cache this result.

maxSize.description: Maximum width/height in pixels, keeping aspect ratio. Defaults to 1024.

scale.description: Scale factor (0.0-1.0). Ignored if maxSize is provided.

resource_id.description: mobile_list_devices 返回的已接入手机 resource_id

name: mobile_set_text
description: 替换当前聚焦的 Android 原生输入框全文，支持中文。先读取当前界面，将刚观察的原文字传入 expected_text；本工具核对旧值、单次填写并读回校验，不点击提交。密码框、无稳定标识的输入框不支持。失败或未知时重新观察，不盲目重试。
